scope: Comment-migration safety and preservation of five known multiline lambda layouts; no Godot run or export was performed during this audit.

fixed_risks.risk: Token-only comparison lost control-flow indentation within multiline anonymous functions inside call parentheses.
fixed_risks.fix: Multiline statements containing anonymous functions additionally compare physical code-line contents and relative indentation; harmless rewrapping can therefore be conservatively rejected.

fixed_risks.risk: Nested functions could inherit comments after their enclosing class changed its base.
fixed_risks.fix: Every enclosing class declaration and direct class-body extends statement participates in the nested declaration context.

regressions_cover: unaffected helper in a changed file
literal hashes, escapes, CRLF and missing final newline
comment_migration.reconstruction_method: All 164 changed sources were confirmed comment-free in raw recovery. Remove inserted full-line comments from the saved prepared output and exactly one appended space before each inserted inline comment. Require each reconstructed source to match the original report source_sha256; replay the pre-fix algorithm and require the exact saved result_sha256. Compare the repaired algorithm output byte-for-byte against that same result.

format_lambda_layout.method: Copy each of the five files from both current learning sources and untouched raw recovery into separate ignored sample trees. Run format_recovered_gdscript.py twice in each tree. Compare each protected function block with its input, allowing only the documented four-space-to-Tab normalization.
